get.summary: Retrieve thumbnails for a file (project scope)
get.description: Returns thumbnail S3 URLs for a pre-processed file. By default all sizes are returned; use the size query param to filter.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Optional thumbnail size filter: small, medium, large

x-code-samples.title: Node.js
Python3
x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPConnection("localhost:8080")

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v1.0/companies/%7Bcompany_id%7D/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/file_processors/preprocess/thumbnails/%7Bitem_type%7D/%7Bitem_id%7D?size=SOME_STRING_VALUE")

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
